body.title: The tool loop and the final structured emit name the call that failed
body.summary: src/analyze/context/driver.ts: ShaperModelCall gains 'tool loop' and 'final structured emit'; classifyOllamaError(err, call) takes the call from its two callers; ShaperLlmUnavailableError is always built with a call, and its Ollama-specific wording is retired. Grounding: callers at src/analyze/context/driver.ts:793 (tool loop) and :959 (runFinalStructuredEmit); the definition is at :1019. The test seam _classifyOllamaErrorForTest (:1683) is called directly by src/analyze/context/__tests__/driver-unit.test.ts:84-137 and model-failure-callers.test.ts:32; those tests are updated to pass a ShaperModelCall. ShaperLlmUnavailableError (driver.ts:149) already takes an optional call (provider-neutral wording with it, 'Local Ollama unavailable ...' without); t3 makes call required, passes it from classifyOllamaError at :1029, and updates the constructions without a call: src/analyze/context/__tests__/driver-unit.test.ts:206, shaper-errors.test.ts:29, src/analyze/orchestrator/__tests__/orchestrator.test.ts:102 and :135, shaper-error-mapping.test.ts:39, :184 and :187.
acceptanceChecks: A CLI provider's failure in the tool loop reads 'The model call for the tool loop failed: ...' and does not mention Ollama.
A failure from runFinalStructuredEmit reads 'The model call for the final structured emit failed: ...'; an Ollama failure's own detail is kept.
The direct test callers of _classifyOllamaErrorForTest (driver-unit.test.ts, model-failure-callers.test.ts) pass a ShaperModelCall and still pass.
